purpose: Final Phase 9D report/evaluation-set integrity hardening before real candidate adapters. No real model was run and no candidate winner was selected.

hardening.missingRuns: Every candidate x scenario pair produces an explicit MISSING_DATA score when no run exists.
hardening.candidateCoverage: Per-candidate/per-split coverage diagnostics report expected, present, scoreable, complete, incomplete, missing, and not-scoreable counts.
hardening.aggregates: Metrics aggregate separately by DEVELOPMENT, CALIBRATION, EVALUATION, and ALL_SPLITS_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
hardening.correctnessVector: Aggregates include expected-strike, missing, verdict, chord, extra, timing, finalized-feedback-age, inference-latency, and publication-delay metrics.
hardening.families: Family metrics aggregate by split using pooled numerator/denominator semantics.
hardening.comparativeOutcome: Outcome distinguishes insufficient evaluation set, split leakage, incomplete evaluation coverage, and evaluation-ready without comparator policy.
hardening.availabilityTimeMs: Availability is publication availability on the performance-origin clock; missing availability does not fabricate feedback-age samples.
hardening.candidateValidation: Candidate definitions, scenario runs, orphan runs, duplicate definitions, duplicate runs, and malformed hashes fail closed.
hardening.completionValidation: Natural completion cannot precede expected strikes; manual stop may leave future strikes NOT_REACHED.
